Goes up when: Eats (BiteFood; a wolf or human from a carcass; GrassFood per bite of grass for a human)
Drinks at a lake or river (DrinkRate; spawns full)
Goes down when: Every tick (ThirstRate; scaled like hunger by activity)

Goes up when: A scare: starting to flee a hunter, once per chase (ScareStress); wandering hungry with no grass in sight (HungerStress)
Goes down when: Halves every StressHalfLife days; back to 0 when it sets off
At the limit: LeaveStress → sets off for new land with a companion (emigrating)
0 → walk only until Stamina is full again

Goes up when: Age ≥ TimeToMature → Adult; Age ≥ ElderAt → Elder

At the limit: 0 → gives birth if there's room; waits if not
For the inspector; none for the first generation

Goes down when: Drunk by boosted grass (one per unit of extra growth)

At the limit: Set when the animal dies: attacked by a species that hunts it (a wolf or human); starved; died of thirst; starved and thirsty; old age; dropped (debug). A nuke leaves no corpse

Goes down when: Eaten by a wolf or human (BiteFood per mouthful)
At the limit: 0 or CorpseDecay days → nothing left to eat; the corpse is bones
A bunny in a hole can't be bitten or hunted

Goes up when: Every tick no bunny stands on it
At the limit: CollapseDays → the hole collapses into bare ground
